The decisive mistake was at step 6. After the scripted retrieval failed at step 4 with a connection timeout, WaybackMachine_Expert claimed to have manually retrieved the menus. It had no tool access to do so, so the menus it listed were fabricated. It then gave "shrimp and grits" instead of the correct singular answer, "shrimp". Verification_Expert only re-checked the fabricated lists against each other and did not catch the problem.

AGENT: WaybackMachine_Expert
STEP: 6
